summary: $36-42 confirmed on the operator page and Campspot; platform operator -> campspot; 50-amp full hookup, 60-ft pull-through; 5-acre lake (weak lead); pin 280 m off; access-hill warning from one camper; seasonal share unknown.
flags: GATE: passes at $36 ($39.08 with Campspot's fees; the $2 reservation fee is once per stay). 2026 RV Life campers paid $45 (Military and undiscounted, pull-through), one $50 (7/2026). No gateway within 40 km (Columbus 68 km), not needed. Not a family stay. gsr.py found no Good Sam match for this name; 8/2026 camper reports a Military discount. Google 4.5 over 171 reviews, open, 740-774-1203.

ACCESS LEAD: a 7/2026 RV Life motorhome reviewer (rating 4 of 10, $50, 'Will not return') opens: 'I feel compelled to do so in this case so folks know what they're getting into. First, there is a road leading to the campground called Blacksmith Hill' and RV Life's API cuts the text there; the rest wasn't readable and a web search found nothing on that road. The other four reviews 2025-2026 (all rating 8, two of them pull-through trailers, one motorhome) don't raise it in what's readable, and one Dyrt review calls it 'a nice scenic drive'. Worth a human read before EKKO goes (not 4WD); the operator's pages give no warning.

LONG-STAY (test 4): sells Annual ($1,834-2,379), Monthly and Weekly beside nightly, plus winter storage, and a homepage testimonial reads 'We spent our first year here'. Share isn't posted; imagery shows three RV blocks that look settled in part. Test 2 passes: nightly posted and Campspot sells single nights.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (weak, upward): stored not waterfront. Operator: 'Spring fed lake', 'Lake 5 acres', 'Walnut Creek runs through the front of our property', and a 'Creekside Getaway Cabin'. Imagery shows the small lake in trees east of the shelter area at about 39.3547,-82.8475, away from the three open RV blocks; no RV pads seen on its shore. Stored value looks right, but per-site positions weren't plotted.
PIN: stored 39.3559,-82.8522 (Google and Campspot too) is the entrance end of Walnut Creek Road, ~280 m from the sites; the RV blocks centre about 39.3554,-82.8490.

CONTACT PAGE CONFLICT: the operator's contact page still says 'you can only make reservations by phone' while its Book Now goes to live Campspot. June 2027 returned 'isn't taking reservations for those dates' (not loaded); no closure.
